chunks: Yet they want to be informed if it is true. Say: 'By my Lord, it is the truth. You cannot invalidate it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Prophet's response to the disbelievers' question about the truth of the Resurrection?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Yunus, the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) is instructed to affirm the absolute truth of the Resurrection to the Quraysh, who sought confirmation of its reality. The divine response emphasizes not only the certainty of the event but also the inevitability of divine retribution, as the disbelievers will be unable to escape or nullify the decree through their denial. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the inevitability of the Hereafter as a core tenet of faith, reinforcing the Prophet's role as the bearer of undeniable truth.
